description: Promote review.lastVerdict to MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT when the loop stops at the round cap, so /cam-ship accepts the terminal state without a manual maxRounds bump.

userStories.title: Signal MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT promotion from decideNextAction at the cap boundary
userStories.description: As the cam supervisor, I need decideNextAction to detect terminal-by-cap with a non-CLEAN, non-MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT verdict and surface that the stored verdict must be promoted to MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT, so the caller can persist the documented debt-but-terminal state instead of leaving FIXES_PENDING:N wedged.
acceptanceCriteria: When all non-operator stories pass, roundsCompleted >= maxRounds, and lastVerdict is a non-terminal pending value (e.g. 'FIXES_PENDING:1' or 'FIXES_PENDING'), decideNextAction returns a terminal action (complete or await-operator) that carries a promotion signal indicating lastVerdict must become MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/decide.test.ts]

When the cap is reached with lastVerdict already 'CLEAN', decideNextAction returns complete (or await-operator if an operator story is pending) WITHOUT any promotion signal (CLEAN handling unchanged). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/decide.test.ts]

When the cap is reached with lastVerdict already 'MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT', decideNextAction returns the terminal action WITHOUT a redundant promotion signal (already terminal). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/decide.test.ts]
The non-terminal, under-cap review path still returns { kind: 'review' } and carries no promotion signal. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/decide.test.ts]

The SupervisorAction type encodes the promotion signal in a typed, discriminable way (not via untyped string), and all existing decide.ts consumers in loop.ts still typecheck. [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
userStories.notes: File: src/supervisor/decide.ts. The terminal-by-cap detection is the `reviewTerminal` computation at lines 116-118 (`roundsCompleted >= maxRounds || (lastVerdict !== null && TERMINAL_VERDICTS.has(lastVerdict))`). decideNextAction is a PURE function (no I/O) per its header contract, so it CANNOT write prd.review; it must SIGNAL the promotion via its return value for the loop (US-002) to persist. Cleanest shape: add an optional typed field (e.g. `promoteVerdictTo?: 'MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT'`) to the `complete` and `await-operator` action variants in the SupervisorAction union, set ONLY when the cap is reached AND lastVerdict is non-null AND NOT in TERMINAL_VERDICTS (i.e. a pending FIXES_PENDING:* value). TERMINAL_VERDICTS = {'CLEAN','MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT'} (decide.ts:54). Do NOT change CLEAN handling and do NOT change the implement/review/blocked branches. Mirror existing decide.test.ts cases (the cap+await-operator+FIXES_PENDING case is already at decide.test.ts:255-265; the complete-at-cap-with-pending case is the new bug case to add). Gotcha (CLAUDE.md): noUncheckedIndexedAccess strict mode is on; keep the union exhaustive. COHERENCE: this is NOT CAM-78's manual cap-bump-to-4 workaround; the fix makes the cap-stop deterministic so no bump is ever needed.

userStories.title: Persist MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT promotion in runSupervisor so cap-reentry exits terminal and ship accepts it
userStories.description: As an operator whose loop stopped at the round cap with a committed fix but a stale FIXES_PENDING:N verdict, I need runSupervisor to persist lastVerdict=MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT when decideNextAction signals the cap-boundary promotion, so /cam-ship's terminal-verdict gate passes without a manual maxRounds bump.
acceptanceCriteria: When runSupervisor reaches the top-of-loop decideNextAction and the returned terminal action carries the MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT promotion signal (US-001), the loop writes prd.review.lastVerdict = 'MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT' via writePrd BEFORE returning the terminal status. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/non-convergence-terminal.test.ts]

Behavioral end-to-end: driving runSupervisor with a prd snapshot where all non-operator stories pass, roundsCompleted == maxRounds, and lastVerdict == 'FIXES_PENDING:1' (the CAM-78 reentry case, no review round dispatched this iteration) results in a terminal status AND a writePrd call whose last review.lastVerdict is 'MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT'. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/non-convergence-terminal.test.ts]

Behavioral ship-terminal acceptance: feeding the resulting promoted prd.json to makeHasPendingStories (src/commands/sidecar.ts, which gates on TERMINAL_VERDICTS) returns false (no manual maxRounds bump needed), whereas the same prd with the unpromoted 'FIXES_PENDING:1' verdict returns true. [oracle: bun test]

CLEAN-at-cap is unchanged: when decideNextAction returns complete without the promotion signal, no MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT write occurs and the existing CLEAN-at-cap test still passes. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/non-convergence-terminal.test.ts]

The existing US-006 post-review promotion path (loop.ts ~1107-1148, promotion immediately after a review round hits the cap) and all existing non-convergence tests remain green (no regression). [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/non-convergence-terminal.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Full CI spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/loop.ts (top-of-loop terminal handling at lines 626-647: the `action.kind === 'complete'` and `action.kind === 'await-operator'` branches), consuming the US-001 promotion signal. When the action carries promoteVerdictTo === 'MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT', read the current prd (already read as `prd` at loop.ts:603), write `{ ...prd, review: { ...(prd.review ?? {}), lastVerdict: 'MAX_ROUNDS_DEBT' } }` via the injected writePrd BEFORE notifyTerminal/return. Reuse the existing formatReviewVerdictLine + notifyOrchestrator + emit('review-verdict-handback') pattern from the US-006 block (loop.ts:1120-1131) for consistency, but this fires at the TOP of the loop (reentry), not after a review dispatch. Do NOT duplicate the round-dispatch promotion: that path (loop.ts:1107-1148) stays; this adds the missing cap-REENTRY promotion. Ship-terminal gate to verify against: makeHasPendingStories in src/commands/sidecar.ts:232-264 (returns false only when all non-operator stories pass AND lastVerdict in TERMINAL_VERDICTS); cam-ship.md Step 1 jq gate only checks passes:false stories, the verdict-terminal gate lives in sidecar.ts/decide.ts TERMINAL_VERDICTS. Test harness: mirror test/supervisor/non-convergence-terminal.test.ts (makeBaseOpts + readPrd returning a queued prds array; capture writePrd copies). The behavioral oracle must drive the loop to cap-reentry (NOT post-review) — set readPrd's FIRST returned prd to already have roundsCompleted==maxRounds && lastVerdict=='FIXES_PENDING:1' with all stories passing, so the FIRST decideNextAction hits the promotion path. Gotchas (memory): supervisor sentinel/verdict parse is a recurring bug class — assert the PERSISTED verdict and the ship-gate boolean, never a tautological grep. CLAUDE.md: never use --no-verify; let check:all run the full spine (CI parity).
